firstScreen.notes: dist/index.html: h1 'Wichita roofing, layer by layer' (5 words, trade+city+outcome); phone in header; primary CTA + secondary present; proof line with Sample tag. Cannot verify fold/peek/intro timing without qa/screens/ (render-check.json confirms missing).

distinctiveness.notes: Layer Stack Cross-Section signature in hero SVG + 7 layer sections with progressive segments (sticky diagram at desktop). Palette Barn Red + Tar + Cream and Barlow Condensed + Outfit + DM Mono pair unique per concept.json. Footer lacks signature integration (-0.5); services grid is 10 identical cards (-0.5).

type.notes: Three-family system: Barlow Condensed 700 display, Outfit variable body ≥16px, DM Mono accent for labels/prices. Fluid scale, tabular-nums on counters, measure capped 64ch. DM Mono at 12px floor prevents 10; no variable weight usage beyond static 700.

layout.notes: Tone alternation paper/deep/paper/deep/paper/accent-break/paper through layers. Asymmetric layer grids (200px diagram + 1fr). Three consecutive t-paper sections (starter→ridge→cleanup) read as one block (-0.5). Services grid is uniform density (-0.5). Cannot verify full-page rhythm without screenshots.

photo.notes: All images niche-appropriate with descriptive alt text, consistent photo-grade filter, width/height attrs, lazy loading. Footer credits show 14x 'Photo by unknown on Pexels' placeholder (-0.5). Cannot verify grade consistency or object-position without screenshots (-0.5).

copy.notes: Voice matches concept sentences; specific trade nouns (OSB, drip edge, Class 4, ridge vent). Sample labels on all reviews/prices/license. Five variants of primary action name (-0.5). Arrow on every service card link is copy tell (-0.5).

mobile.notes: Breakpoints at 640/900px. Mobile bar with call+quote, hidden ≥900px. Layer diagrams hidden <640px. Inputs 48px height. Filmstrip uses horizontal scroll at mobile which may push CTAs below fold (-0.5). Cannot verify 390x844 composition without screenshots.

a11y.notes: Skip link, focus styles 3px solid var(--focus), reduced-motion resets all animations and shows content. No-JS fallback visible. Form labels present. Compare slider missing aria-valuemin/max/now (-0.5). Cannot verify reduced-motion screenshot completeness.

motion.notes: Split-text intro, clip-path layer segments, stagger reveals, hover underline. Same fade-up reveal on every data-reveal element (-1.0). Cannot verify intro ≤1.2s or story reversibility without render.json (-0.5).

wow.notes: Layer-stack cross-section tied to thesis is strong conceptually. Estimator output is plain text range, not designed in signature language (-1.0). Cannot verify reduced-motion static form (-0.5).

polish.notes: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon, OG 1200x630, theme-color, JSON-LD RoofingContractor, print stylesheet for estimator, forced colors handled. Mixed radius (2px buttons, 999px pills, 0 frames) reads inconsistent (-0.5). Cannot verify forced colors rendering.

elevate.move: Drive the estimator output with the same clip-path wipe verb as the layer stack, so the price range reveals in the signature's language rather than appearing as plain text.

Break the services grid into two density zones — a dense 2x3 block for core services and a quieter single-row strip for specialty services — using alternating tones to create rhythm and eliminate the 10-card monotony.
